description: This is a C source file implementing an OpenAMP remote application for Zephyr RTOS, involving inter-processor communication, shared memory setup, and VirtIO device initialization.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_get_status
methods.description: Reads the status of the virtio device via sys_read8.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_get_features
methods.description: Returns the features supported by the virtio device, specifically VIRTIO_RPMSG_F_NS.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_notify
methods.description: Notifies the remote processor via IPM, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: platform_ipm_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon IPM message reception, signals data reception semaphore.

methods.name: endpoint_cb
methods.description: RPMsg endpoint callback that receives data and signals data reception semaphore.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_unbind
methods.description: Unbind callback for RPMsg endpoint, destroys the endpoint.

methods.name: receive_message
methods.description: Receives a message from the RPMsg endpoint, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a message via RPMsg endpoint.

methods.name: app_task
methods.description: Main application thread that initializes shared memory, IPM, VirtIO, and runs message exchange loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that creates the application thread.
